title: Bounds for the centered Hardy-Littlewood maximal constant
abstract: Proves that the weak type (1,1) constant c_2 of the centered maximal operator over axis-parallel squares is at least the explicit radical phi, approximately 1.68551, using a weighted periodic lattice and integrable approximations. Also proves c_d <= 2^d in every natural dimension and 1.685 < phi < 1.686. The operator acts on real-valued integrable functions, with Lebesgue outer measure of strict level sets. Includes the maximal-function API, a Vitali covering argument, lattice witnesses, smearing estimates, and the limiting lower bound. No optimality of phi is claimed.

informal.LeanPool.CenteredMaximal.ofReal_phi_le_w: The explicit radical phi is a lower bound for c_2, the infimum of all weak type (1,1) bounds for the centered maximal operator over axis-parallel squares in the real plane.
informal.LeanPool.CenteredMaximal.weakTypeConstan: For every natural number d, including zero, the centered maximal operator over axis-parallel cubes in real d-space has weak type (1,1) constant c_d at most 2^d.
informal.LeanPool.CenteredMaximal.phi_mem_Ioo: The explicit radical constant phi lies strictly between 1.685 and 1.686.
